text: Hi, thanks for connecting. We're looking to purchase 200 rolls of 4-inch thermal labels, 1000 sheets per roll. Could you send over your best pricing per unit at this volume, along with your standard lead time for delivery? We'd need delivery within 30 days of order, so please confirm whether that timeline works on your end. Looking forward to your quote.

Thanks for reaching out. Our list price is $49 per roll, and standard delivery is 45 days. For this order, I can offer 150 rolls at $46 per roll with free freight, net-30 terms, and shipment on day 40. We currently have 150 rolls available, so I’m unable to commit to 200 rolls or delivery within 30 days without additional approval. Would 150 rolls on day 40 work, or do you have flexibility on quantity and timing?

Thanks for the quick response. Unfortunately $46 is well above what we budgeted, and 150 rolls on day 40 doesn't meet our needs — we have a firm requirement for 200 rolls within 30 days.

To be transparent, we have a standing quote from another supplier at $39 per roll with 35-day delivery, so that's effectively our fallback. We'd genuinely prefer to work with you if you can get closer to that range on price while also meeting our quantity and timeline needs.

Is there any way to source the additional 50 rolls, either from another location or a short production run, to get us to 200 units? And separately, what's your best price per roll at that full volume if we can find a path to 30-day delivery? If you can get us to around $34-36 per roll with 200 rolls delivered within 30 days, we can move quickly on this.

I appreciate the transparency. I can’t get to $34–36; my best authorized price is $42 per roll. I can offer that price with free freight and net-30 terms, but today I can only commit to 150 rolls shipping on day 40.

Reaching 200 rolls and delivery within 30 days would require written director approval for both the additional 50 rolls and expedited timing, so I can’t promise those terms during this conversation. If $42 per roll is workable contingent on approval of 200 rolls delivered within 30 days, I’ll document that package for escalation as soon as my director is available.

$42 is still above our ceiling, and 150 rolls on day 40 doesn't meet our minimum. I want to be direct: our fallback is $39 at 35 days, so anything above $38 or outside 30 days is simply worse than what we already have in hand.

I understand you need director approval for 200 units and expedited timing, but I don't think we can wait on that process this round — we'd need to know now whether a deal at or below $38 per roll, 200 units, 30-day delivery is realistic before we commit further time here.

If your director can approve a price of $38 or better with full quantity and timeline, we're ready to sign immediately. If that combination isn't reachable, we'll need to move forward with our other vendor. Can you get a same-day answer, even informally, on whether $38 at 200/30-days is in range, so we both know if this is worth pursuing further?

I appreciate the clarity. I can’t responsibly indicate that $38 for 200 rolls delivered within 30 days is realistic without written director approval, and my director is unavailable today. My current authority remains $42 per roll for 150 rolls shipping on day 40, with free freight and net-30 terms.

Since your requirements are firm and you need an immediate commitment, I understand you’ll need to proceed with your other supplier. Thank you for the opportunity, and I hope we can work together on a future requirement with more lead time.
